home.faqHowToUpscale: How to upscale images with AI using DLSS 5?
home.faqHowToUpscaleAns: Upscaling images with DLSS 5 is simple: just drag and drop your JPG or PNG file into our web interface. Our neural network will process the image on NVIDIA H100 GPUs and return a high-resolution version in seconds.
home.faqProfessional: Can I use DLSS 5 for photos and professional work?
home.faqProfessionalAns: Yes, DLSS 5 is specifically engineered for professional photo upscaling. Unlike generic AI, our Neural Super-Resolution model preserves architectural lines, skin textures, and intricate patterns without introducing artifacts.
home.faqNeuralSrAns: Neural Super-Resolution is a deep learning technique that predicts high-resolution pixels based on patterns learned from millions of high-quality images. It creates new data to fill in gaps that standard scaling methods simply ignore.
home.faqApi: Is there an API for developers?
home.faqApiAns: Absolutely. We offer robust API documentation for integrating DLSS 5 high-resolution AI upscaling into your own applications, CMS, or automated pipelines.

docs.title: API Documentation
docs.subtitle: Integrate DLSS 5 upscaling directly into your applications.
docs.authDesc: All API requests require a Bearer token in the Authorization header.
docs.authCurlExample:
curl -X POST https://api.monolith.ai/v1/upscale \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer YOUR_API_KEY" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{
    "image_url": "https://example.com/image.jpg",
    "scale": 4,
    "model": "ada-5.0"
  }'
